norm.limitation: The system API reference names the JS setOsAccountDistributedInfoByLocalId API; the IDL method SetOsAccountDistributedInfo differs only by the ByLocalId suffix, and the native service forwards to OhosAccountStateChange. Applicability is a Builder-LLM mapping, not a human review; the operation candidate remains ambiguous because two OhosAccountStateChange overloads share argc 3.

applicabilityRationale.SetOsAccountDistributedInfo: js-apis-distributed-account-sys.md:126-136 section setOsAccountDistributedInfoByLocalId declares MANAGE_DISTRIBUTED_ACCOUNTS; account_mgr_service.cpp:203-232 checks PERMISSION_MANAGE_DISTRIBUTED_ACCOUNTS before calling OhosAccountManager::OhosAccountStateChange. The IDL/JS name difference is the ByLocalId suffix only.

review.rationale: Builder-LLM accepts the single SetOsAccountDistributedInfo mapping for MANAGE_DISTRIBUTED_ACCOUNTS. Applicability is a Builder judgment, not independent verification; the expected policy anchor for this permission is not established in this round, and the operation target remains ambiguous because two OhosAccountStateChange overloads share argc 3.
